thread:
lia: Quick ping — I'm planning a TF change to add a Dedicated H100 node pool for inference-heavy jobs. Need a fast sanity-check on taints/labels, capacity reservation flags, and secret wiring. Thinking reserved + spot fallback to g5. @alex @sam :eyes:

alex: SGTM. couple q's: 1) do we want a hard taint so only specific workloads land there? 2) fallback logic — prefer compatible gpu family or fallback to smaller gpus?

sam: For 1) yes, hard taint + toleration on the inference daemonset. For 2) prefer same-arch GPUs first (h100 -> h100v2 variants) then g5 for throughput degraded. We should avoid automatic p4 fallback because memory/layout differs.

lia: Thinking node taint: `gpu=exclusive:NoSchedule` on h100-reserved pool. Workloads add toleration + nodeSelector label `family=h100`. Example K8s pod snippet I had in mind:
```yaml
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "gpu"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "exclusive"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  nodeSelector:
    family: "h100"
```

maria: Terraform side — propose new module args in our `nodepools` module: `instance_types`, `capacity_preference`, `reserved_capacity = true`, `fallback_instance_types = []`. Draft snippet:
```hcl
module "nodepool_h100_reserved" {
  source = "./modules/nodepool"
  name = "inference-h100-reserved"
  instance_types = ["nvidia-h100-v2"]
  min_size = 2
  max_size = 20
  reserved_capacity = true
  fallback_instance_types = ["g5.48xlarge","g5.12xlarge"]
  labels = { "family" = "h100", "role" = "inference" }
  taints = [{ key = "gpu", value = "exclusive", effect = "NoSchedule" }]
}
```

sam: Couple small callouts: - ensure we annotate pool with AZ spread constraints so reservations don't get fragmented. - secure secret wiring: the nodes need access to KMS alias `projects/redwood/keys/gpu-kms` for encrypted AMIs. Put IAM role on instance profile instead of exposing keys in TF state.

alex: Rolling update strategy — when we switch existing inference pods to new pool, we should do canary 10% -> monitor latency/cost -> 50% -> full. Use PodDisruptionBudget and maxUnavailable=1 for model servers. Also set `maxSurge: 1` in daemonset or deployment to avoid cold-start spike.

lia: Good. Ops question: spot preemption handling — if fallback kicks in, do we want to fallback to on-demand g5 only, or allow mixed spot+on-demand? I lean to allow spot in fallback but with capacity pool `min_on_demand = 1` for critical traffic. Thoughts?

maria: That matches our cost policy. In TF we can set `spot = true` for fallback pool and `min_on_demand = 1`. Also add a label `burst=true` so autoscaler policies treat them differently.

sam: One more infra nit: local NVMe ephemeral scratch for model cache — h100 nodes have local_nvme=true. Ensure CSI driver tolerates ephemeral disks and our eviction thresholds are higher (e.g., kubelet eviction grace 5m) so large caches don't OOM pods.

alex: I can add the TF PR for module change + example k8s manifests. Will include upgrade plan and rollout steps. I'll ping `#eng-oncall` when testing to monitor GPU SLOs.

lia: Awesome. @alex please add TODO: verify AMI patch level + nvidia driver compat in the PR. If anyone objects to the plan comment here today, otherwise I'll approve once PR is up. :thumbsup:
